chapter_title: The Chapter of the Three Seasons

spiritual_reading.full_translation:
From the first emergence of wisdom into manifestation, and its being subjected to falsity and denial, until the final elevation of the ultimate recipient in which the whole measure of wisdom that had been entangled with falsity is separated, purified, and restored—between those two bounds there unfold three distinct processes.

The first process runs from the point at which the primal good that engages evil directly was let down into the lowest obscurity, where it entered combat against the ruling love of evil and the allied falsities that proceed from it. It overcame; yet the operative powers that belong to it were still held detained within those mixed lower states, amid the opposing forces, until the primal good gathered the dispersed elements back under order and constrained them so that none could escape its governance. It thus achieved a great victory. It endured long successions of states, as if through many lifetimes and generations, within that obscurity and opposition, until it prevailed and carried out the Divine intention laid upon it.

After this, a restoring Divine operation was sent forth, proceeding from sustaining good. By that operation the primal good was lifted out of conflict and brought back into the state of manifested wisdom and peace. This entire span—from the descent into the lowest obscurity to the ascent into illumination—constitutes the first process.

The second process begins from that ascent. Restoring power again went forth, together with the wisdom-principle that gives life. By their conjoint work the whole ordered structure of degrees and their containing forms was arranged and established, until the connected system stood completed. This span is reckoned as the second process.

Once that order was established, a further Divine manifestation extended living truth into the formed system for reception. Through it, whatever could be purified as beauty from the mixed powers was separated and gathered upward into higher states, and whatever was mere refuse of evil and falsity was driven back into the lowest obscurity, with a fixed distinction between what could be raised and what must be cast down. From the moment this manifestation was made perceptible, the purification of wisdom advanced; but evil surged upward in resistance, and the manifestation was withdrawn from open perception. Then falsity shaped systems of perverted perception, and from these issued works without genuine spiritual birth, which fell out of order. Afterward there was fashioned in the outermost degree a merely external semblance of the human—will and understanding bound to sensuous life. This continued until a saving influx of Divine truth was sent into those states; it accomplished its use there, implanted hope in the first formed human condition, and was then elevated again into higher illumination.

From the first perceptible appearance of that Divine manifestation until the final elevation of the ultimate recipient at the completion is reckoned as the third process.

The spans of these processes are unequal. The first—because it consists of sustained combat in obscurity and opposition—extends through an exceedingly great succession of states, far exceeding the other two.

If one attempts to measure the intermediate span, its magnitude varies by the standpoint of comparison: in one reckoning it seems multiplied many times, in another greater still, and in other reckonings less; for the ways lower states are received and carried on among many can prolong succession, while the elevation of what can be raised into higher illumination hastens conclusion. 

The third process—from the first perceptible manifestation until the final elevation of the ultimate recipient out of indistinct mixture—is greater than the intermediate process, yet it does not reach the vastness of the first. The intermediate process—in which restoring power together with life-giving wisdom disposed the ordered structure and its uses—is shorter than the first.

Great, therefore, is the duration of the first process: it exceeds the duration that runs from the perceptible Divine manifestation to the dissolution of the established system and the final elevation. And the duration from that manifestation until dissolution likewise exceeds the duration of the intermediate ordering by which restoring power and life-giving wisdom formed and arranged the connected system.

These alone are the three processes by which the whole course is measured.

paragraph_translations.translation: From the first emergence of wisdom into manifestation, and its being subjected to falsity and denial, until the final elevation of the ultimate recipient in which the whole measure of wisdom that had been conjoined with falsity is separated, purified, and restored: between these bounds the whole course is summed into three distinct processes.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS: it sets the total frame and names the threefold structure.

paragraph_translations.translation: The first process is from the time when the primal good that engages evil directly descended into the lowest obscurity and entered combat against the ruling love of evil together with the allied falsities that belong to it. It was victorious; yet the operative powers that proceeded from it remained detained among those opposing states within their own domain, until the primal good gathered the dispersed elements back under order and constrained them all so that none could escape its governance. Thus it gained a great victory. It endured long successions of states, as if through many lifetimes and generations, within that obscurity, until it prevailed and fulfilled the Divine intention entrusted to it.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS: it fills out what the first process consists of and why it is long.
paragraph_translations.notes: The source has several textual uncertainties/brackets; the sense of “caught all of them” and “in his net” was rendered as gathering and constraining under order.

paragraph_translations.translation: After this, a restoring Divine operation was sent forth, proceeding from sustaining good. By this operation the primal good was drawn up out of conflict and brought back into the state of manifested wisdom and peace. This span—from descent into the lowest obscurity to ascent into illumination—is the first process.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: it completes the first process by deliverance and return.

paragraph_translations.translation: The second process begins from the ascent of the primal good. Restoring power went forth together with the wisdom-principle that gives life, and by their conjoint work the whole ordered structure of degrees and containing forms was arranged and established, until the connected system stood complete. This entire ordering up to completion is reckoned as the second process.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS: it moves from combat-and-rescue to construction and ordering.
paragraph_translations.notes: The source repeats titles and includes bracketed cosmology (“firmaments”); rendered generally as ordered degrees and containing forms.

paragraph_translations.translation: After the ordered system was established, a further Divine manifestation extended living truth throughout what had been formed for reception. By it, whatever could be purified as beauty from among the mixed powers was separated and gathered upward into higher states, and whatever was mere refuse of evil and falsity was driven back into the lowest obscurity, with a fixed distinction between them. From the moment that manifestation became perceptible, the purification of wisdom advanced. Then evil surged upward in resistance toward it, and so the manifestation was withdrawn from open perception. From falsity there then arose a forming of perverted perceptions, and from these issued works without genuine spiritual birth, which fell away from order. Afterwards there was fashioned in the outermost degree a merely external semblance of the human—will and understanding bound to sensuous life. This continued until a saving influx of Divine truth was sent into those states; it accomplished its use there, gave hope to the first formed human condition, and was then elevated again into higher illumination.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS: it narrates the third process’s opening and the emergence of resistance and restoration.
paragraph_translations.notes: Several named figures (Third Ambassador, Jesus, Adam/Eve) were translated by function: Divine manifestation of truth; saving influx; first formed human state in externals. “Trees” and “abortions” were rendered as perverted perceptions and barren works; exact nuance of “abortions” remains uncertain.

paragraph_translations.translation: From the first perceptible appearance of that Divine manifestation until the final elevation of the ultimate recipient at the completion is reckoned as the third process.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: it defines the bounds of the third process explicitly.

paragraph_translations.translation: The first process extends through a very great succession of states, because the primal good remained long within obscurity and opposition; its duration surpasses the other two processes.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS: it compares durations and elevates the first as longest.
paragraph_translations.notes: Paragraph numbering in the source skips; treated as given.

paragraph_translations.translation: If one tries to measure the intermediate process, its magnitude varies by the standpoint of comparison: in one reckoning it appears multiplied many times, and in another greater still, while in other reckonings it seems less. For lower states are prolonged when many receive and carry on perverted perceptions and their derivative works, yet they are shortened when what can be raised is taken up out of the lowest degree into higher illumination. At this point the account breaks off.
paragraph_translations.connection: BREAKS: the sense turns to comparative measures but the source becomes fragmentary.
paragraph_translations.notes: The source is damaged/elliptical (“This is […]”, braces, broken syntax). “Fruits/trees/earth/heights” were rendered as works from perceptions, the natural degree, and elevation into illumination.

paragraph_translations.translation: This is the third process: from the time the Divine manifestation was made perceptible until the final elevation of the ultimate recipient out of indistinct mixture. Its duration is greater than the intermediate process, yet it does not equal the duration of the first. The intermediate process, in which restoring power together with life-giving wisdom arranged the ordered structure and its uses, is shorter than the first process.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: it resumes clear comparison among the three spans.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Lump” was taken as undistinguished mixture in the ultimate recipient; exact image is obscure but the functional sense is stable.

paragraph_translations.translation: Great is the duration of the first process: it exceeds the span that runs from the perceptible Divine manifestation until the dissolution of the established system and the final elevation. Moreover, the span from that manifestation until dissolution exceeds the duration of the intermediate ordering in which restoring power and life-giving wisdom formed and arranged the connected system.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS: it intensifies the duration comparisons in a nested way.

paragraph_translations.translation: These alone are the three processes by which the whole course is measured.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: it closes by reaffirming the complete threefold scheme.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Coherent as a three-stage spiritual history: (1) descent into obscurity and combat, (2) ordering of degrees into a stable system, (3) purification through manifestation, resistance, and saving influx, ending in final elevation. The main stumble is paragraph 10, which is textually fragmentary; the comparative-point remains but details break. Otherwise it reads as a single doctrinal voice focused on process and duration.

findings.diagnosis: Clean chapter frame: establishes a threefold temporal/process schema with clear bounds (from first emergence/crucifixion of light to final ascent/purification). No disruption of narrative or voice.
findings.evidence: Text teaches by functional process and states over time: “from the time when the light came forth and was crucified in the darkness… until… the entire light… will be purified and cleansed… totals three seasons.” The spiritual reading reports no stumble here and treats it as a coherent macro-frame (“between those two bounds there unfold three distinct processes”).

findings.diagnosis: Clean substrate narrative of the first season: descent → struggle → victory → long duration → rescue/ascent. Some bracketed/damaged clauses, but they do not introduce a new voice; they only create local syntactic uncertainty.
findings.evidence: Functional story is continuous: “First Man went down… waged the war… victorious… sons remain behind… bound them all up… spent human lifetimes… fulfilled the will… Then they sent the Living Spirit… brought the First Man up… This is the first period.” The spiritual reading notes uncertainties (“caught all of them,” “in his net”) but does not report a narrative break; it can still derive meaning by function (combat, binding, duration, deliverance).

findings.diagnosis: Clean second-season definition; repeats divine titles but remains in process/ordering mode (construction of the universe until completion). The repetition is stylistic or duplicative copying, not a jurisdictional list or rank-inventory.
findings.evidence: Text: “They set in order the things of the universe… set up the firmaments… set in order all the universe… until it was completed… reckoned to the second season.” The spiritual reading explicitly notes only cosmetic repetition/brackets and keeps a stable functional reading (“ordered structure of degrees… arranged and established”). No stumble recorded.

findings.diagnosis: Largely clean third-season narrative (manifestation → separation/purification → resistance → concealment → corrupt productions → formation of Adam/Eve → sending of Jesus → hope → ascent), but it is a MIXED seam: correspondential process language is continuous, while several mythic proper names look like later historicizing/identificatory overlay that the spiritual reading had to translate away into functions.
findings.evidence: The chapter’s process teaching is clear: “separated beauty… swept the waste… set a boundary… purified the light… Sin spurted up… hid his image… sculpted the trees… abortions fell down… sculpted Adam and Eve… until… Jesus was sent… gave the hope… ascended.” The spiritual reading flags this implicitly by method: “Several named figures (Third Ambassador, Jesus, Adam/Eve) were translated by function,” i.e., the reader had to neutralize names to keep the functional narrative. That is typical of a seam where an older process-teaching has been overlaid with identifying labels (especially “Jesus”) without otherwise changing the underlying sequence of states.
findings.scope: Annotate ¶5 as containing historicizing/identificatory overlay names embedded in an otherwise correspondential process narrative (Third Ambassador; Adam and Eve; Jesus). Do not excise, because removing names would leave the same sequence of actions and the paragraph still teaches coherently by function.

findings.diagnosis: Clean boundary statement for the third season; no disruption.
findings.evidence: “from the time when the Ambassador displayed his image until… the Statue will ascend… reckoned to the third season.” The spiritual reading reports steady continuity (“defines the bounds… explicitly”).

findings.diagnosis: Clean comparative duration note; reinforces the functional reason for length (time spent in darkness). Numbering gap is editorial, not textual voice change.
findings.evidence: “[The first season] lasts long… very great count of time, more than the (other) two seasons!” The spiritual reading: “compares durations… elevates the first as longest,” with no narrative break; it treats the numbering skip as external (“treated as given”).

findings.diagnosis: Genuine textual damage/fragmentation causes the main stumble: syntax breaks, comparative-measure illustration becomes incoherent, and the line about “trees/fruits… years and generations… earth… heights” is truncated. This is not an administrative insertion; it is a broken explanatory aside about reckoning time.
findings.evidence: Text shows clear lacunae and unstable readings: “If you should say that [the intermediate season] it is small… consult someone… Twenty times… Thirty times! Less also… people will receive the {} of the trees [fruits]… carry up from the] earth to the heights. This is […” The spiritual reading explicitly reports: “BREAKS… source becomes fragmentary… braces, broken syntax… account breaks off.” Removing it would not reveal a hidden smooth narrative; it would simply drop the (otherwise relevant) attempt to explain why measurements vary.

findings.diagnosis: Clean resumption after the damaged aside: reasserts third-season bounds, compares the three durations, and closes the triadic scheme. No evidence of insertion; it repairs coherence by returning to the chapter’s main structuring function (relative lengths).
findings.evidence: “This is the third period… greater than the intermediate… does not come equal to… For this intermediate season… is shorter… Great is the period of the First Man… These are the [only] three periods.” The spiritual reading notes a clear “resumes clear comparison” immediately after ¶10, which is exactly what you expect when a marginal explanatory example has been lost mid-copy: the main discourse continues intact.

textual_criticism.summary: 8 findings: 6 clean correspondential sections (¶1; ¶2-3; ¶4; ¶6; ¶8; ¶11-13), 1 mixed seam requiring annotation (¶5-6 context; specifically ¶5’s embedded proper-name identifications), and 1 genuine difficulty due to textual damage (¶10). Recommendations: annotate 1 block; excise none; none-action 7.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: From the time when the light came forth and was crucified in the darkness, to the season when the Statue will ascend and the entire light, which was conjoined with the darkness, will be purified and cleansed. From that time on, from that time to the season of the end totals three seasons.

Three seasons: from the time when the First Man went down to the abyss, and waged the war and the struggle against the King of the realms of Darkness and his other powers. He was victorious, while his sons remain behind with them in the worlds [and in the heavens] in the [midst] until he shall catch all of them [worlds of darkness] he bound them all up, so that not one of them escaped his hand. He won a great victory [in his net] The First Man spent human lifetimes and generations in the land of darkness, until he prevailed [afterwards] ⟨p.56⟩ he fulfilled the will of the greatness that was commanded of him.

Then they sent the Living Spirit, the Father of Life. He brought the First Man up from the struggle, he brought him up to the land of light. This is the first period, from the descent of the First Man to his ascent.

The second season is from the time when the First Man ascended. The Living Spirit came, and the Mother of Life. They set in order the things of the universe, they set up [the firmaments] the Father of Life and the Mother of the living set in order [all] the universe, up to the moment when they go out [from it, until it was completed] it was reckoned to the second season.

[Afterwards] the universe [was established,] the Third Ambassador spread [his light] that is in the [universe of the] living; he [gathered it;] he separated beauty from all the powers and scooped it up to the heights, he swept the waste to the abyss, and he [set a boundary between them] Now, from the moment when the Ambassador revealed his image he purified the light. Sin spurted up towards him. He hid his image. Sin came [up] from the darkness. It sculpted the trees and the abortions fell down. Afterwards they sculpted Adam and Eve in the flesh. Until the moment when Jesus was sent and he [again] as he performed there his will. He gave the hope to Adam, and ascended to the heights.
Now, from the time when the Ambassador displayed his image until the season when the Statue will ascend at the end, shall be reckoned to the third season.
[The first season] lasts long in the time that the First Man spent in the world of darkness. It is a very great count of time, more than the (other) two seasons!

[He replies to them]: If you should say that [the intermediate season] it is small, if you should [consult someone] to him [again] and you consult [someone else] you will tell him: Twenty times! It is greater again in this other one that you will consult: Thirty times! Less also is this other one [in another reckoning,] people will receive the {} of the trees [fruits] the years and the generations [they will carry up from the] earth to the heights. This is [...

This is the third period, from the time when the Ambassador revealed his image until the Statue will ascend from the lump. It again, that time, is greater than the intermediate; but it does not come equal to the time of the First Man. For this intermediate season, in which the Father of Life and the Mother of Life constructed the universe with its orders, is shorter than that of the First Man.

Great is the period of the First Man! It lasts longer than the season in which the Ambassador displayed his image, until the dissolution of the world and the Statue ascends. From the time too when the Ambassador displayed his image, until the dissolution of the universe [it is greater than the season] when the Father of Life and the Mother of Life shaped the universe.
These are the [only] three periods of time that occur. ⟨p.58⟩

changes_summary: No changes made. The only non-none recommendation was Finding 4 (annotate ¶5 for embedded proper-name overlay), and per rules, annotations do not alter the chapter text. No excisions were recommended in any finding.
